entries.target: Foreigner: Ha… riga…
Foreigner: Kakh ze kore. Lo mevinim otkha, pokhadim mimkha, ve ata…
Foreigner: Hayiti noten hakol kedei lirot oto shuv. Ani kol kakh mitgaagea. תראאה, ma ze omer?
Foreigner: Ani ohev tmunot. Ata kanire lo maarikh otan…
Foreigner: בודקק kan… Ze lo nire nakhon…
Foreigner: Einayim kmo einayim. Lama lehafkhid?
Foreigner: Tsarikh lishtof et hayadayim…
Foreigner: Ata yodea she tafru li et hape. Akhshav ata gam mekaven rove ve יוורה be kulam…
Foreigner: Ve ma akhshav?!
Foreigner: Ha-ha…
Foreigner: Ben adam! Tafsik! Eize shtuyot!
Foreigner: Al! Ani tov! Anakhnu pashut lo mevinim ze et ze!
Foreigner: Taziz et harove! Lo asiti lekha shum davar ra!!!
Foreigner: Lama, ma yesh lekha!? Asiti ma sheratsita!!!
Foreigner:
Foreigner: Agil me hakhaver hayakar sheli.
Foreigner: Oznayim kmo oznayim.
Foreigner: Tare li?
Foreigner: Tmuna? Ani mamash ohev et ze!
Foreigner: Merutse?
Foreigner: Ani lo mevin et kol ze… Nu, beseder…
Foreigner: Ani adayin lo mevin lama ata tsarikh et kol ze… שמשש yekhola lisrof et hareshetit. Ani lo מסתכלל al שמשש.
Foreigner: Einayim?
Foreigner: Lama ata ose et kol ze? הורגג bishvil hakeyf?
Foreigner: Yadayim? Beseder.
Foreigner: Ve ma akhshav?
Foreigner: Ma? Ata matzbia al פהה? Ken, tafru oto. Ve ma akhshav? Lekhayekh?
Foreigner: Ani lo mevin shum davar. Ma ata rotse mimeni?
